slides.title: Investify
body: F26-003-Investify
FYP-1 mid-evaluation working draft
Educational equity decisions with recorded evidence and checked explanations
slides.speaker_notes: Introduce the team and supervisor. The preparation date is 12 October 2026, not a confirmed assessment date. Present the actual implementation and disclose the historical model limitation.

slides.title: The problem
body: A Buy/Hold/Sell label leaves the evidence and uncertainty unexplained.
An explanation can sound plausible while contradicting its recorded values.
An evaluation can overstate performance when information is aligned after its availability time.
slides.speaker_notes: Explain the retail-user interpretation task. Investify is educational and does not execute orders. Its numerical consistency checks and temporal controls must be evaluated independently of predictive usefulness.

slides.title: Project contributions

rows: Alignment, leakage controls and audit evidence
Market data, exchange calendars and modelling libraries
Record checks, contradiction gates and verified fallback
Stored SHAP attributions and an optional generator

slides.speaker_notes: Separate implemented engineering contributions from research novelty. FinBERT, XGBoost and TreeSHAP are external components. The closest-work comparison and broader novelty claim still need review. Current working implementation, tests and assessment drafts include disclosed assistant contributions. Student implementation/review ownership and understanding require genuine evidence; this slide assigns none.

slides.title: Implemented scope
body: Historical NVDA decisions from two news experiments
Five technical and six news features; 186 saved decisions per corpus
Complete checked explanations and an explicit prototype risk profile
Separate retrospective risk-dependent blend; saved classifier unchanged
slides.speaker_notes: The full proposal remains broader. The separate blend fits 148 earlier feature rows and scores 38 later sessions per corpus. Its profile weighting is unvalidated for suitability/performance. Social sentiment, raw inputs and scientific reproduction remain pending.

slides.title: The explanation path
body: A validated decision record supplies probabilities, feature values and attributions.
The context builder supplies all feature meanings and coverage limits.
The verifier checks visible sentences and JSON independently.
Rejected or unavailable generation selects a verified deterministic explanation.
slides.speaker_notes: Use the report architecture source when the slide renderer is available. The local LLM adapter has bounded retries and records failed attempts. Distinguish ready integration code from an actually evaluated model.

slides.title: A reproduced verifier defect

rows: Wrong displayed confidence beside correct JSON
Wrong feature definition beside correct JSON
Missing advisory notice in visible text

slides.speaker_notes: Demonstrate one real saved record with a deliberately edited statement. This is a labelled corruption, not a market forecast. Keep the candidate failure report separate from the successful fallback report.

slides.title: Teacher and student explanation study

rows: Six actual controlled-prose examples; factual JSON assembled from records
Same student trained on accepted examples

slides.speaker_notes: The user selected the current assistant as teacher; an additional Qwen teacher download is not required. The original open-weight teacher assumption is changed, with the original proposal preserved. Raw prose is actually assistant-generated, the structured payload is deterministic hybrid supervision. Both are checked. Exact teacher serving revision is unavailable. Training and validation are grouped by trading date, and the final 38-date test block is excluded. Six all-Buy examples do not establish adequate training data, student performance or human understanding.

slides.title: Prediction limitation
body: Successful explanation verification does not establish predictive usefulness.
slides.speaker_notes: State the limitation before the panel discovers it by changing dates. Examine calibration and class distribution together. Do not claim useful trading returns, and do not alter thresholds to manufacture a positive result. The saved results belong to the preserved historical calibration-transfer implementation. Current source defaults to frozen_classifier and has an explicit refit_transfer comparator with corrected temporal boundaries. Only fixture/mock orchestration is validated; no genuine fitted comparison or new predictive score exists.

slides.title: Live demonstration
body: Select a corpus/session and inspect technical/news evidence.
Show rejection and fallback for wrong prose beside correct JSON.
Request the complete guided explanation and show actual model/fallback status.
Complete the prototype profile and compare separate blends on a held-out date.
slides.speaker_notes: Start the portable server before the presentation and use its printed loopback URL. The current default has no configured LLM, so its guided result is explicitly deterministic. Use real generation only after model access is restored and its results are recorded. The Leakage Lab optional labelled feature check runs nine checks and detects four centred mutations without fitting a classifier. Keep its synthetic-fixture scope visible. The saved market canary is not a fresh run. For portable recovery, show Retry selected record, Refresh sources and Retry profile questions if a dependency fails. Source refresh keeps a still-available selection; accepted empty sources remove stale records/reports. Profile retry requires new explicit answers. Verification returns a candidate rejection and verified fallback separately; its successful checking operation uses HTTP 200. The numeric verification fallback and complete guided comparator have distinct coverage.

slides.speaker_notes: Sampling was amended from unavailable NVDA to MSFT before acquiring tweet contents. StockNet source revision and original Git blobs are retained. Exact session model identity is configuration-declared, not provider-authenticated. The 24 held-out references include only two negatives and may overlap public pretraining. These labels cannot establish NVDA transfer or return prediction. Candidate weights/runtime are unavailable. The proposal action register still has open items. One held-out prediction changes exact agreement by 4.17 points; negative recall moves in 50-point increments. Token-similarity screening flags zero pairs under the declared heuristic, which does not establish independence.
